rule.title: Taxes Schedule A does not allow

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this a tax Schedule A does not allow — federal income or excise tax, social security or Medicare tax, customs duties, federal estate or gift tax, tax on gasoline, car inspection fees, assessments for sidewalks or other improvements, tax paid for someone else, license fees, or foreign personal or real property tax?

citation.wording: Social security, Medicare, federal unemployment (FUTA), and railroad retirement (RRTA) taxes.
